# Interactive Proposal

> Build interactive proposal pages - a single-file, project-branded HTML page a prospect can click through, with a version-switcher hero, per-version scope, team, timeline, assumptions, boundaries, and a call to action.

**What it does.** Builds a single-file interactive proposal page that a prospect can click through. The page lets a prospect switch among scoped versions.

**Use it when.** Asked for an interactive proposal, proposal page, quote page, clickable proposal, web version of the DDOC, scope explorer, or option explorer for a pursuit.

**Not for.** Do NOT use for the PPTX Deal Decision deck itself (that is ddoc) or a generic slide proposal deck (deck-builder).
